segments.text: I bought this bag for one vacation, and now I carry it everywhere. I wanted a summer bag that didn't look flimsy or feel like a beach toy, and that's when I found the Velantra Straw Tote. The hand woven seagrass gives it that vacation feel, but what surprised me was how much it actually holds. Phone, sunscreen, my book, even a water bottle, everything goes in and the bag still keeps its shape. The leather handles and that belted flap keep everything secure, at the beach or out at dinner. And with seven colorways, it somehow works with every outfit I pack. It's structured, lightweight, and honestly makes every errand feel a little more like a getaway. And judging by the reviews, I'm definitely not the only one loving it. Grab the Straw Tote before your colorway sells out.
